finding: A deterministic nominated loop can remain unvisited while another loop runs indefinitely; terminal-only exhaustion does not bound extra Before/After hooks.
budget_role: Resource bound for the temporary recording Unit only; not a new hotness/admission counter or policy selector.
contracts: Consume the temporary Unit budget even before the nominated loop is reached; ordinary baseline Units have no recorder budget/hook overhead.

After budget exhaustion, finish the current semantic operation exactly once and settle to ordinary baseline at a validated AFTER boundary; terminal actions touch only pinned Unit metadata and defer cold service to fresh ownership.
Consume the one-shot recording attempt before callback-capable allocation; detach session pointers before free and revalidate after replacement/free before any borrowed exec/frame access.
Do not nominate another loop, infer heat of an unvisited loop, add retries, raise quotas or extend source/native budgets.
Keep zero-iteration/early-return and alternate-hot-loop behavior in the existing eight runtime fixture categories, alongside replacement/free callback invalidation.
budget_reason: Separate temporary Unit lifetime bound from active event-buffer capacity; the reviewed4096-event default leaves room to reach and record a nominated loop while still bounding all temporary hooks.
prepublication_correction: Initial root draft conflated the512-event recording buffer with lifetime instrumentation; author/reviewer4096 lifetime proposal adopted before any new root instruction, binding or publication.
